clearing.rim: steady, blinks in the last 3 s
clearing.ring: drains: lit = ceil(24 x left / clearing)
clearing.dots: go dark from both kerbs toward the middle, in step with the seconds left
clearing.note: the window is closing: the figure still walks, the numerals count down

arriving.note: the last 3 s of STOP: the window is opening, counted down

faces.note: One block per part drives both faces. Colour crossfades CROSSFADE_S, glyphs cut. Digits: clearing = ceil(seconds left), arriving = 3, 2, 1; under ten the tens part takes `blank`; walk and stop take `blank` on both digit parts.

ring.lit: _Cutoff = 1 - lit / 24 lights exactly `lit` segments clockwise from local -Y (the way across the road)
ring.placement: the SignalLens's own transform: same pivot (the beam's foot) and yaw
ring.clearing: drains: lit = ceil(24 x left / clearing)

dots.uv: u = metres from the module's -X end to the dot's centre (the same for every vertex of a dot, so a dot is lit or dark, never cut); v = metres across the row
dots.gate: a dot is lit when _LitFrom <= u <= _LitTo; per module, from the module's own u; a dark dot shows its charcoal enamel seat
dots.clearing: go dark from both kerbs toward the middle, in step with the seconds left

cycle.clearingSeconds: ceil(W / 1.4), W = kerb-to-kerb carriageway width crossed (m)
cycle.stopSeconds: 14 + clearing, its last 3 s are ARRIVING
cycle.phase: (missionSeconds + offset(id)) mod cycle, cycle = walk + clearing + stop
cycle.offset: FNV-1a 32-bit of the crossing id's UTF-8 bytes, mod cycle (deterministic: the same on every replay; mission clock, never frame time)
cycle.order: walk, clearing, stop (the last 3 s arriving)
cycle.status: [S] look only; the sim reads nothing from it

stateNeverOnColourAlone.rule: every pair of states differs by the figure, the numerals, the rim motion or the ring motion, not only by colour
